create_score_api: create a score endpoint that computes relevance scores between queries and documents via POST /score
create_score_v1_api: create a deprecated score endpoint at POST /v1/score that redirects to /score with a warning
create_rerank_api: create a rerank endpoint that ranks documents by relevance to a query via POST /rerank
create_rerank_v1_api: create a deprecated rerank endpoint at POST /v1/rerank conforming to the JinaAI rerank API
create_rerank_v2_api: create a rerank endpoint at POST /v2/rerank for JinaAI-compatible document reranking
